test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Some simple changes in eating habits can __alleviate__ nausea.
solution:
The correct answer is **relieve**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Alleviate: **to make something less strong or bad. (पीड़ा या कष्‍ट के) प्रभाव को कम करना
 
• **Relieve: **to make an unpleasant feeling or situation stop or get better. कष्‍ट या चिंता में राहत पहुँचाना
 
• Thus, the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence is given in <
